component.name: Lighthouse Power Manager
component.summary: Control SteamVR lighthouse base stations over Bluetooth

description.p: Turns SteamVR lighthouse (Valve Index, HTC Vive, and V2 (2.0) base stations) on, off and standby over Bluetooth Low Energy, and organizes them into named groups and nicknames.

Lighthouses normally sleep while the SteamVR runtime is running; this app is the companion for switching them back on without opening Steam. BLE scanning and GATT go through BlueZ D-Bus directly, so it works on the Valve Steam Frame, which does not ship QtBluetooth.
First release of the BlueZ D-Bus rewrite for the Valve Steam Frame (aarch64). Self-contained: bundles the firmware Qt 6.8 / KF6 / Kirigami / glibc under /app/rootfs.
